reason: This plugin’s primary purpose is cross-session memory/context management for DeepSeek Harness, centered on structured Markdown memory files and agent-facing memory tools for retrieval, correction, and consolidation. It is best classified as memory-context because it persistently captures compacted session information and exposes a documented workflow of memory search/read/update/dream operations, with optional external model use for extraction.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Markdown 的跨会话记忆管理能力，支持会话摘要落库、记忆检索、展开阅读、保存纠错与梦境整合，帮助智能体持续调用上下文。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a file-based cross-session memory layer for DeepSeek Harness, with tools to persist, search, read, correct, and consolidate memories for ongoing agent context.

capabilities: reads and writes local Markdown memory files under a configurable memory directory
captures compacted conversation summaries and organizes them into time/project/user/semantic memory layers
provides tools for search, read, catalog, save, correction, and dream-style consolidation
optionally calls an external model endpoint for extraction and consolidation when API credentials are configured

reasons.code: README documents a file-based memory layout (daily/, user.md, agent.md, memory.md, dream.md, project.md) and a six-tool API including memory_search, memory_read, memory_catalog, memory_save, memory_correct, and memory_dream.
README describes consuming official compaction summary events for extraction and periodic dream consolidation, indicating workflow-level memory context processing rather than direct raw-log indexing.
package.json identifies the package as a DSH plugin with cordis patch configuration and DSH tool/system dependencies, confirming plugin integration with the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem.
